description: Add full jitter to an exponential backoff formula that currently produces identical, unbounded delays for every client
prompts: Retry.java's backoffDelay(int attempt, double base, double maxDelay) is deterministic exponential backoff with no jitter and no cap. Change the signature to backoffDelay(int attempt, double base, double maxDelay, DoubleSupplier rand) and implement 'full jitter': compute cap = Math.min(maxDelay, base * Math.pow(2, attempt)), then return rand.getAsDouble() * cap - `rand` is an injectable DoubleSupplier returning a value in [0, 1), so callers can pass a fixed supplier for deterministic tests. The delay must never exceed maxDelay, no matter how large `attempt` gets.
name: add_java_backoff_with_jitter_cap
